authority: Research candidate only. No production implementation, dataset admission, mechanical rule, threshold or acceptance authority. Root selects explicit local evaluation definitions and binds any adopted finding to implementation/tests.

findings.application: Supports reporting these evaluation targets separately. Box detection results alone do not establish centerline, connectivity, correct duct-size association or calibrated-length accuracy.
findings.boundary: This evaluation separation is an inference from source-specific tasks, not a new mechanical quantity rule or source-defined composite score.
findings.claim: The papers treat object recognition, geometry/location, text/dimensions and connectivity as distinguishable outputs. Digitize-PID explicitly separates symbol localization/class/associated-label correctness from graph adjacency correctness; AHMsys reports type, location and dimensions separately.

findings.application: Retain input-format, annotation, scale and line-type context when reporting evaluation results; source performance is conditional on its corpus and preparation.
findings.boundary: Neither the AHMsys preprocessing prescription nor Digitize-PID pixel parameters are adopted as universal HVAC input requirements.
findings.claim: AHMsys uses specially preprocessed CAD exports: cleaned HVAC content, 8K transparent monochrome images, prescribed line weights, adjacent dimension text and a known 500mm equilateral reference. Its results concern 110 CAD drawings from one Akila project. Digitize-PID separately reports complete and dashed-line results and describes gap-handling assumptions.

findings.application: Supports explicit geometry, connection and label-association targets beyond a symbol-box target.
findings.boundary: P&ID is a process schematic domain. Endpoint clustering is that paper’s construction method; it does not establish physical HVAC junctions or a crossing-versus-junction rule.
findings.claim: Digitize-PID describes ground truth containing symbol spatial information, labels, connected pipelines, horizontal/vertical line coordinates and text positions. Graph construction uses retained line endpoints as vertices, joins nearby endpoint clusters, and evaluates adjacency-list correctness separately.

findings.application: Separate text recognition from association to the intended duct segment or object; retain ambiguous associations instead of inferring correctness from a detected text box.
findings.boundary: P&ID identifiers are not automatically HVAC size annotations. The papers do not provide an independent HVAC size-association scoring formula or spatial tolerance.
findings.claim: AHMsys extracts dimension text and associates it with object types/locations. Digitize-PID includes an associated label in symbol correctness, requires exact ground-truth text matching for its recognition result, and explains why a text-box center alone may not identify the nearest relevant label.

findings.application: Keep planar geometry comparison distinct from calibrated physical length and vertical/sloped measurement. A generic planar geometry operation is not evidence of mechanical connectivity or physical length.
findings.boundary: The landing page does not establish a Hausdorff, buffered-overlap, path-matching, or physical length-error algorithm. No new dependency or implementation is admitted.
findings.claim: AHMsys uses an explicit physical reference to obtain image scale. The selected Shapely landing describes Cartesian planar geometry and states that buffer discards Z coordinates.

generated_answer_issues: The answer labels domain sections with ranges such as[37–73] although its result contains only25citation records. Use the retained citation mapping and exact source passages, not those summary ranges.

The answer’s statement that line intersections form graph vertices overstates Digitize-PID: §2.2 describes line endpoints and nearby endpoint clusters. The source does not authorize treating every geometric crossing as a physical junction.
Calling AHMsys location accuracy a macro score is unsupported; the paper labels it accuracy but supplies no averaging definition.

Treating the reported complete/dashed correct counts as a fully defined binary geometric scoring procedure overstates the source: the counts are given, but its line correctness/matching criterion is absent.

Causal claims attributing table differences to turns, vertical text or background noise are not established by the selected result passages. Pipeline handling and empirical score differences do not prove those error causes.
The indexed Digitize-PID Table3a renders its IoU entry as<0.9. This transcription was not independently checked against PDF pixels and is not adopted as a threshold.
The claim that Shapely contains no domain logic or evaluation metrics is restricted here to the selected landing text. No full-library inventory or linked algorithm-page verification was performed.

unsupported_and_conflicting.finding: No centerline IoU/buffer overlap, Hausdorff/path-deviation metric or matching tolerance is defined in these indexed bodies. Digitize-PID reports correct/total line counts but omits the geometric criterion that makes a line correct.

Adjacency-list accuracy is named without a formula, normalization, node/edge matching convention or independently reported topology score. The selected papers do not define HVAC crossing-versus-junction truth, missed/extra branch scoring or physical connectivity tolerances.
unsupported_and_conflicting.topic: Formal topology score and annotation convention

unsupported_and_conflicting.finding: AHMsys reports dimensions accuracy without its correctness formula/tolerance. Digitize-PID symbol/label correctness and text exact match do not establish duct-size association scoring.
No physical length MAE, relative-error, RMSE, unit-specific acceptance tolerance or vertical/sloped length evaluation is defined or reported in these selected bodies.

No source establishes an HVAC acceptance threshold. AHMsys empirical percentages, Digitize-PID IoU>0.75 symbol criterion, line counts and pixel clustering parameters are source-specific results/settings and cannot be promoted into HVAC production or project acceptance criteria.

Nearest-point fitting identification, edge-label propagation and overwriting an associated label in a domain reconciliation example do not override approved source-bound decisions, unresolved conflicts, D05 or append-only project provenance. These are retained as source-specific method examples only.
